# Communication Diagram — Component Interactions

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Browser["Browser\n(ERP IT Admin / Business User)"]
    N8N["N8N Workflow\n(Bearer Token)"]
    NGINX["NGINX Ingress Controller\n(:443 TLS)"]

    subgraph AppPod["ERP API Token Manager App (ASP.NET Core 8 :8080, Min Replicas ≥ 2)"]
        TokenCtrl["ApiTokensController\n/api/v1/me/tokens"]
        AdminCtrl["AdminTokensController\n/api/v1/admin/*"]
        PocCtrl["PocController\n/api/v1/demo/*"]
        AuthMW["ApiTokenAuthenticationHandler\n(Bearer Token Auth Middleware)"]
        RazorUI["Razor Pages UI\n/ApiTokens/* (含 AuditLog 頁)"]
    end

    PG["PostgreSQL 16\n(:5432)\nschema: erp_token"]
    Redis["Redis 7\n(:6379)\nIdempotency cache 24h"]
    Prometheus["Prometheus\n(:9090)"]
    OtelCollector["OtelCollector\n(:4317 gRPC)"]
    Jaeger["Jaeger\n(:14250 gRPC)"]
    Grafana["Grafana\n(:3000)"]
    AlertManager["AlertManager\n(:9093)"]

    %% Message 1: External traffic → NGINX
    Browser -->|"1: HTTPS :443\n(Razor Pages / REST API)"| NGINX
    N8N -->|"1: HTTPS :443\nBearer Token"| NGINX

    %% Message 2: NGINX → App
    NGINX -->|"2: HTTP :8080\n(forwarded request)"| RazorUI
    NGINX -->|"2: HTTP :8080\n(forwarded request)"| TokenCtrl
    NGINX -->|"2: HTTP :8080\n(forwarded request)"| AdminCtrl
    NGINX -->|"2: HTTP :8080\n(forwarded request)"| AuthMW

    %% AuthMW pipeline
    AuthMW -->|"2a: pipeline intercept\n(before PocCtrl)"| PocCtrl

    %% Message 3: App → PostgreSQL (erp_token schema)
    RazorUI -->|"3: TCP :5432\n(EF Core / Npgsql)"| PG
    TokenCtrl -->|"3: TCP :5432\n(EF Core / Npgsql)"| PG
    AdminCtrl -->|"3: TCP :5432\n(EF Core / Npgsql)"| PG
    AuthMW -->|"3: TCP :5432\n(token_hash lookup)"| PG

    %% Message 3b: App → Redis (idempotency)
    TokenCtrl -->|"3b: TCP :6379 RESP\n(Idempotency-Key cache)"| Redis

    %% Message 4: Prometheus pulls metrics
    Prometheus -->|"4: HTTP :8080/metrics\n(pull scrape)"| AppPod

    %% Message 5: App → OtelCollector
    AppPod -->|"5: OTLP gRPC :4317\n(traces)"| OtelCollector

    %% Message 6: OtelCollector → Jaeger
    OtelCollector -->|"6: Forward Traces :14250\n(gRPC)"| Jaeger

    %% Observability side
    Grafana -->|"Query :9090"| Prometheus
    Prometheus -->|"Alerts :9093"| AlertManager
```

## Numbered Message Sequence

| # | 訊息 | 協議 | 端口 | 說明 |
|---|------|------|------|------|
| 1 | Browser/N8N → NGINX | HTTPS | 443 | 所有外部流量的唯一入口，TLS 終止 |
| 2 | NGINX → App | HTTP | 8080 | NGINX 轉發解密後的 HTTP 請求至 App Pod |
| 2a | AuthMW intercept → PocCtrl | ASP.NET Core Pipeline | - | ApiTokenAuthenticationHandler 在 PocController 前自動攔截驗證 |
| 3 | App → PostgreSQL | TCP / Npgsql | 5432 | EF Core 透過 Npgsql 驅動存取 PostgreSQL（schema=erp_token）|
| 3b | App → Redis | RESP | 6379 | UpdateDescriptionUseCase 透過 RedisIdempotencyKeyStore 存取 Idempotency 快取（24h TTL）|
| 4 | Prometheus → App | HTTP Pull | 8080/metrics | Prometheus 主動拉取 /metrics 端點的指標資料 |
| 5 | App → OtelCollector | OTLP gRPC | 4317 | App 推送 OpenTelemetry Traces 至 Collector |
| 6 | OtelCollector → Jaeger | gRPC | 14250 | Collector 轉發 Traces 至 Jaeger 儲存和查詢 |

## Component Roles

| 元件 | 角色 | 說明 |
|------|------|------|
| Browser | Client | ERP IT Admin 和 Business User 使用的 Web 瀏覽器 |
| N8N Workflow | Automation Client | 自動化工作流引擎，使用 Bearer Token 呼叫 POC API |
| NGINX Ingress Controller | Reverse Proxy / TLS Termination | 統一入口，TLS :443 → HTTP :8080 |
| ApiTokensController | REST API | Self-service Token API，`/api/v1/me/tokens`（CRUD + PATCH UpdateDescription）|
| AdminTokensController | REST API | IT Admin API，`/api/v1/admin/*` |
| PocController | Demo REST API | 演示 API，`/api/v1/demo/*`（需 Bearer Token）|
| ApiTokenAuthenticationHandler | Auth Middleware | ASP.NET Core 自訂驗證 Handler，驗證 Bearer Token |
| Razor Pages UI | Web UI | Token 管理介面，`/ApiTokens/*`（含 IT Admin AuditLog 頁）|
| PostgreSQL 16 | Database | schema=`erp_token`，儲存 `api_tokens` 與 `token_audit_logs` |
| Redis 7 | Cache | Idempotency-Key 快取（24h TTL）— for UpdateDescriptionUseCase |
| Prometheus | Metrics Collector | 拉取 App 指標，儲存時序資料 |
| OtelCollector | Trace Aggregator | 收集並轉發 OpenTelemetry Traces |
| Jaeger | Distributed Tracing | 分散式追蹤儲存和 UI 查詢 |
| Grafana | Dashboard | 查詢 Prometheus，可視化指標 Dashboard |
| AlertManager | Alert Router | 接收 Prometheus 告警，路由通知 |
